painpoints.text: Run 01M2Y59HMPN1RTB0NBDAXB1EBG tester bounce cost a full gate cycle because the prior implementer pass appended smoke assertions after closeout-smoke.nu's trailing `exit 0` (dead code — the smoke still printed ok, so the pass self-verified green on unexecuted assertions) and invented seed id 'fabro-9abc', which prompt-lint rejects as unresolvable in the tracker. Suggestion: the smoke script could move its success print + exit guard into a `def main`-style tail or assert its own last-line position; cheaper: a prompt-lint rule that flags code AFTER a top-level `exit 0` in sourced smoke scripts would have caught both defects deterministically at implement time.

observations: prompt-lint greps loop-asset scripts for fabro-XXXX literals, not just prompts — any seed-id literal written into .fabro scripts must resolve via sd show at write time; this is a stricter constraint than the fabro-41de prompt rule and worth remembering when writing test fixtures with provenance strings.
